headline: Boston Properties: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
summary: BOSTON (AP) — Boston Properties Inc. (BXP) on Tuesday reported a key measure of profitability in its second quarter.  The real estate investment trust, based in Boston, said it had funds from operations of $283.4 million, or $1.78 per share, in the period.  The average estimate of six analysts surveyed by Zacks Investment Research was for funds from operations of $1.71 per share.
